newsitem.title: USA: AEP Communications in pact with Sprint.
newsitem.headline: AEP Communications in pact with Sprint.

text.p: AEP Communications Inc, a subsidiary of American Electric Power said on Tuesday that it entered into an agreement with Sprint Communications Inc to jointly construct a 150-mile fiber optic line between Charleston, West Virginia and Roanoke, Virgina.

AEP Communications said it would share the expenses to build the fiber optic line to provide its parent with network upgrades, while Sprint adds alternate routing and additional capacity between West Virginia and Virginia. The work is scheduled to begin in spring 1997.
AEP Communications will also offer services to wireless personal communications services license holders for the establishment and maintenance of their PCs networks.
Sprint has $12.8 billion in annual revenues and serves more than 15 million businesses and residential customers.
